text:
```yaml
name: Mark stale issues and pull requests

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 1 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          # General settings
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          days-before-stale: 60
          days-before-close: 7
          operations-per-run: 30

          # Stale issue settings
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had
            recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you
            for your contributions.
          close-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically closed because it has been stalled for 7 days
            with no activity. Please open a new issue if you believe this is still relevant.
          stale-issue-label: "stale"
          exempt-issue-labels: "pinned,security,help wanted"

          # Stale PR settings
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had
            recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs. Thank you
            for your contributions.
          close-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been automatically closed because it has been stalled for 7 days
            with no activity. Please open a new pull request if you believe this is still relevant.
          stale-pr-label: "stale"
          exempt-pr-labels: "pinned,security,help wanted"

          # Exempt users
          # exempt-all-milestones: true
          # exempt-all-assignees: true
```
